originals.ko: 아주 좋아, 하지만 점점 늦어지고 있어
originals.why: Here iawn stands alone as 'right/okay', but this course teaches it as 아주 'very'. Wrong sense, and no gloss-faithful Korean fits it, so the learner cannot reach bare 'iawn'.

originals.ko: 나는 곧장 집에 가고 싶어, 왜냐하면 점점 늦어지고 있거든
곧장 집에 가는 게 더 좋을 거야, 왜냐하면 점점 늦어지고 있거든
나는 기차를 타야 해, 왜냐하면 점점 늦어지고 있거든
originals.why: Natural North Welsh and fits this seed; rhaid i mi is used in its taught sense, 'I have to'.

originals.ko: 멈추지 말자, 왜냐하면 점점 늦어지고 있거든
나는 커피 한 잔 하고 싶었어, 하지만 점점 늦어지고 있어
originals.why: Natural Welsh. 'panad o goffi' is used in its taught sense, 'a cup of coffee'.

topups.why: Only 1 BUILD needed and B02 already fills it. This one is fine otherwise.
Ends on a dangling 'ond', which is weaker as a BUILD, and the Korean -지만 doesn't mark the open end with ~.

refill.why: The Welsh ends on a hanging 'ond' that adds nothing to practise, and the Korean -지만 hides that the sentence is unfinished, so the BUILD is weak and its open end is unclear.
